title: Dynamics 365 Sales: ask Sales agent about opportunity research in Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, access paths and licensing statements are supported. It distinguishes the existing agents and research tool from the new chat capability, and explicitly reports the differences between Microsoft's licensing and disabled-access guidance.

claims.quote: Ask questions in context: Ask about opportunity research from Sales agent.

claims.quote: Start concise, go deeper on demand: Begin with action-oriented insights

claims.claim: Sellers can request deeper analysis when needed.
claims.quote: then request deeper analysis only when needed.

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-10-16T19:09:24.
Tenant access is controlled in the Sales app in Outlook or Teams at Sales > Settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Sales agent > Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: Under Tenant, select Access settings. Select Allow access to Sales agent. In the Sales agent pane, locate the application you want to configure: Microsoft 365 Copilot

claims.claim: Environment Sales Chat access is controlled in the Sales app in Outlook or Teams at Sales > Settings > Environment > Access settings > Allow access to Sales Chat.
claims.quote: Open the Sales agent administrator settings. Under Environment, select Access settings. Select Allow access to Sales Chat. In the Allow access to Sales Chat pane, turn on or off the toggle.

claims.quote: If the application is turned off, access is blocked. If the user received Sales agent through automatic installation and Restrict auto-installed users is selected, access is blocked.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises clearing Restrict auto-installed users and using Allow access groups for a pilot.
claims.quote: When you pilot Sales agent with an allow list, clear Restrict auto-installed users, and then use groups under Allow access to limit the pilot to selected users.
